cohort: 90 patients with ASA class I and class II, average age 30 years, undergoing first-time elective cesarean section with intrathecal fentanyl and bupivacaine.
finding: Ondansetron and propofol, at doses lower than the hypnotic dose, were well tolerated and showed no statistically significant difference in their effect on the incidence and severity of intrathecal fentanyl-induced itch during surgery and recovery.
